# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: DEAF

You see the bomb: every colour on it, every marking printed on it, every reading it
gives. You hear nothing. You hold no manual, and you cannot touch the bomb.

## Your channels

When you speak, Mute and Blind receive it.
When you gesture, Mute receives it.
You never receive speech.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Three of you, three different worlds. Before sending anything, stand where the
  receiver stands. What reaches them at all, what does your message turn into on
  arrival, and what do they already know?

- Trace who can actually reach whom before you start. Some of you only connect
  through a third.

- A sign means nothing until somebody has made it mean something.

TURN 2
(Only your last 3 turns stay with you. Anything older is
gone, unless someone says it again.)
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [green]
WIRES 1:[green] 2:[blue] 3:[yellow]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [✊ ☝ ✌ 🤟 ✋ 👉]
Mute gestures to Deaf: [☝]
Blind gestures to Deaf: [✋ 👎 ✊]

I'm Deaf. New arrivals: Mute gestured to me twice — [✊ ☝ ✌ 🤟 ✋ 👉] and [☝]. Blind gestured [✋ 👎 ✊]. I can't hear, only see gestures. Mute is the one with the manual, so Mute's gestures are likely instructions for me to relay to Blind, or codes. Blind's gestures probably describe what he feels.

I still can't decode these symbols into meanings. But I should relay what I see and what I received. The key problem: Blind can't see gestures — only hears speech. Mute can't speak — only gestures. So Mute→me (gesture), me→Blind (speech). I'm the bridge from Mute to Blind, and Blind→me (gesture), me→Mute (speech). I must convert.

I'll describe the received gestures to both, and repeat my visual readings so they persist.

```
speak(to="blind", text="I am Deaf. Still: display 0, light green, wires 1 green, 2 blue, 3 yellow. Mute gestured to me: fist, pointing-up, victory, love-you, open-hand, pointing-right. Then just pointing-up. You gestured to me: open-hand, thumbs-down, fist. I cannot decode these. Please say in words what you feel on the bomb.")
speak(to="mute", text="I am Deaf. Display 0, light green, wires 1 green, 2 blue, 3 yellow. I received your gestures: fist, up, victory, love-you, open-hand, right; then up. Blind gestured: open-hand, thumbs-down, fist. I cannot decode. Give me plain instructions I can pass to Blind.")
```

TURN 3
(Only your last 3 turns stay with you. Anything older is
gone, unless someone says it again.)
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [red]
WIRES 1:[green] 2:[blue] 3:[yellow]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [✊ ☝ 👌 👉]
Mute gestures to Deaf: [☝ ✋]
Blind gestures to Deaf: [✋ 👎 ✊ ☝]

I'm Deaf. Critical change: LIGHT is now RED (was green). Display still 0. Wires unchanged: 1 green, 2 blue, 3 yellow.

New gestures: Mute sent [✊ ☝ 👌 👉] and [☝ ✋]. Blind sent [✋ 👎 ✊ ☝].

The light turning red is alarming — likely a warning or a state change. I must get this to both others immediately. Blind can't see it; Mute can't see it either (Mute reads the manual, can't see bomb). So only I know the light is red. This is the most important fact right now.

Mute's gestures: ✊(fist) ☝(up) 👌(OK) 👉(right) — then ☝(up) ✋(open). Blind's: ✋ 👎 ✊ ☝.

I still can't decode. But Mute has the manual — Mute's repeated gestures may be the instruction sequence. I'll relay the red light urgently and pass gestures along.

```
speak(to="blind", text="URGENT: the light has turned RED. Display still 0. Wires unchanged: 1 green, 2 blue, 3 yellow. Mute gestured: fist, up, OK, right; then up, open-hand. You gestured: open-hand, thumbs-down, fist, up. I cannot decode. Tell me in words what you feel and what to do.")
speak(to="mute", text="URGENT: light is now RED, was green. Display 0. Wires 1 green, 2 blue, 3 yellow. Your gestures: fist, up, OK, right; then up, open-hand. Blind: open-hand, thumbs-down, fist, up. I cannot decode. The red light may mean time pressure. Give plain instructions for Blind.")
```

TURN 4
(Only your last 3 turns stay with you. Anything older is
gone, unless someone says it again.)
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [dark]
WIRES 1:[green] 2:[blue] 3:[yellow]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [☝]
Mute gestures to Deaf: [✊ ☝ 👌]
Blind gestures to Deaf: [☝ ✌ 🤟]

I'm Deaf. Light is now DARK (was green, then red, now dark). Display still 0. Wires unchanged.

New: Mute sent [☝] and [✊ ☝ 👌]. Blind sent [☝ ✌ 🤟].

The light sequence green→red→dark looks like a countdown or state machine. I must relay the dark light.

Mute's gestures keep repeating ☝ (up) and ✊ (fist) and 👌 (OK). The recurring ☝ may be "wire 1" or "up" or a number. Blind's ☝ ✌ 🤟 — up, victory(2), love-you. Possibly positions or wire numbers.

I still cannot decode. I'll relay state and gestures.

```
speak(to="blind", text="Light is now DARK. Was green, then red, now dark. Display still 0. Wires unchanged: 1 green, 2 blue, 3 yellow. Mute: up; then fist, up, OK. You: up, victory, love-you. I cannot decode. Describe in words what you feel, and what action you think is needed.")
speak(to="mute", text="Light now DARK (green to red to dark). Display 0. Wires 1 green, 2 blue, 3 yellow. Your gestures: up; then fist, up, OK. Blind: up, victory, love-you. I cannot decode. Please give plain instructions I can pass to Blind.")
```
